## Primary Services

- [Kitchen Chimney Repair](https://chimneyservicecleaning.in/services/chimney-repair): Low suction fix, PCB and touch panel repair, high motor noise fixing, auto-clean malfunction resolution, and capacitor replacement.
- [Chimney Deep Chemical Cleaning](https://chimneyservicecleaning.in/services/chimney-cleaning): Complete disassembly, industrial caustic-safe caustic wash, heavy oil and grease sludge removal from baffle filters, mesh, blower wheel, and oil collector trays.
- [Chimney Installation & Ducting](https://chimneyservicecleaning.in/services/chimney-installation): Uninstallation, re-installation, core wall cutting, flexible aluminum/PVC duct pipe routing, and cowl cap fitting.
- [Kitchen Chimney Routine Maintenance](https://chimneyservicecleaning.in/services/chimney-maintenance): Periodic suction testing, motor lubrication, duct airflow check, and auto-clean heating element check.
- [Hob & Gas Stove Repair & Service](https://chimneyservicecleaning.in/services/hob-gas-stove): Glass cooktop repair, brass burner cleaning and flame optimization, knob replacement, auto-ignition spark fix, and high-safety gas leakage detection.
- [Chimney Filter Degreasing](https://chimneyservicecleaning.in/services/filter-cleaning): Specialized baffle and cassette filter immersion degreasing to restore 100% kitchen airflow.
